## Fixes

- Fix sudo elevation in terminal always asking for a password
- Fix paths containing a tilde not being resolved properly for SSH
- Fix username detection failing on systems without the id command
- Fix SSH ProxyJump connections not using local config correctly
- Fix winget updater not working
- Fix SSH config parsing for Include directives, quoted values, and key=value syntax
- Fix network scan failing to parse some nslookup outputs
- Fix serial connection parity settings not being applied properly
- Fix Tailscale integration failing when no other devices are in the tailnet
- Fix Podman quadlet restarts not working for rootful containers
- Fix Proxmox container IP detection picking loopback or IPv6 addresses
- Fix Proxmox VNC setup modifying snapshot sections and adding duplicate arguments
- Fix file browser write permission check failing for some files
- Fix KeePassXC integration freezing when KeePassXC is not responding
- Fix API shell sessions not being managed properly for concurrent requests
- Fix adding SSH config entries for external tools removing other host entries from the user SSH config file
- Fix connection default actions not updating when a tunnel is started or stopped
- Fix Kubernetes contexts not being listed when no current context is set
- Fix SFTP errors for VM connections not being shown
- Fix first SSH connection after startup on Windows failing when the installation path contains spaces or special characters
- Fix MCP run script tool not finding the script and requiring optional arguments
- Fix file browser listing failing for some symbolic links
- Fix file browser showing wrong times for PowerShell systems
- Fix file transfer rename all choice also renaming files without a conflict
- Fix terminal multiplexer sessions not being tracked properly with multiple panes and a slow multiplexer start opening a second instance
- Fix Warp terminal failing to open on Linux for some paths
- Fix user SSH config options, e.g. ForwardAgent, not being applied for connections using jump servers
- Fix renaming vault users and roles not working
- Fix SFTP symbolic link creation using the wrong argument order
- Fix file browser directory sizes not working on BSD-based systems
- Fix file transfers possibly hanging after a connection loss
- Fix Wake-on-LAN not working on some systems and for MAC addresses written with dashes
- Fix Hyper-V VMs with multiple network adapters getting an invalid IP address
- Fix Webtop Proxmox containers ignoring the locale setting
- Fix RDP file import not handling IPv6 addresses
- Fix RDP gateway not working for associated hosts
- Fix RDP and VNC quick connect not using the default port
- Fix Remmina custom options not being applied properly
- Fix KeePassXC custom location being lost
- Fix HTTP errors without a response body not being shown properly
- Fix sessions of dependent connections not being closed when a connection is edited or deleted
- Fix various NullPointers

## Changes

- Improve git vault commit signing to properly support SSH signing keys
- Show the public key for SSH config connections that use an identity file
- Improve network scan to work on more systems
- Improve confirmation dialog for actions launched from URLs
- Custom service commands now use $ADDRESS instead of $PORT as a placeholder to allow for more flexibility
- Prevent script URL and git sources with the same file name overwriting each other (This might require a script source refresh)
- Improve TigerVNC support on macOS
- Unavailable workspace dirs are now kept and shown as unavailable instead of being removed
